summary: Completed full backend and frontend testing for Dev Settings Screensaver feature. All features working correctly - menu item present, settings page with Image A/B URLs and counts, Video URL, save/reset functionality, API auth, and persistence verified.
critical_code_review_comments: DevScreensaverSettings.jsx: Uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements - GOOD for testability
DevScreensaverSettings.jsx: clampCount function correctly clamps values 0-60
DevScreensaverSettings.jsx: Uses axios for API calls with Bearer token auth
DevSettingsLayout.jsx: Screensaver menu item at path /dev/settings/screensaver with Monitor icon
AdminScreensaver.jsx: Fetches settings on mount from /api/admin-settings/screensaver
AdminScreensaver.jsx: createBubbleImageList uses counts from API settings
admin_settings.py: ScreensaverSettings model with image_a_url, image_b_url, image_a_count, image_b_count, video_url

context_for_next_testing_agent: Screensaver settings feature fully implemented. Dev Settings sidebar has 'Screensaver' menu item under Platform section. Settings page at /dev/settings/screensaver allows configuring: Image A URL + count, Image B URL + count, Video URL. API endpoints GET/PUT /api/admin-settings/screensaver require admin auth. AdminScreensaver component fetches these settings at runtime to use configured images/counts/video for the idle overlay.
